task: Add gitleaks pre-commit hook to backend by porting codemie-ui validate-secrets.mjs to a cross-platform bash script with container-engine detection (Docker/Podman/Apple Containers).

key_reasoning.reason: Ported from an existing UI reference (validate-secrets.mjs), so the pattern was known. Cross-platform container-engine detection (Docker/Podman/Apple Containers with daemon-live checks) adds minor bash complexity, but the script is fully self-contained and trivially reversible by removing the pre-commit hook entry. Bumped from S to M by the security/compliance red flag (the hook is a secrets-scanning gate).

One new file (scripts/git-hooks/validate_secrets.sh, 151 lines), one pre-commit config entry (6 lines added to .pre-commit-config.yaml), a 2-line Makefile bug fix, and a documentation update to quality-gates.md. All changes are confined to developer tooling; no application components are touched.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from S(2) to M(3): Security/Compliance requirement — the hook enforces a hard-block secrets-scanning gate on every commit.
